Scene:
一天，很久很久以前，孟子和他妈妈住在中国。孟子妈妈的工作是祭拜，孟子不高兴，因为他说我们老是搬家，为什么？他妈妈说，从早到晚，我一直祭拜，很多墓地得我祭拜。所以我们得去很多不同的地方。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 一天，很久很久以前，孟子和他妈妈住在中国：delete一天；better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子妈妈的工作是祭拜：wrong information, it’s not his mother’s job
- 孟子不高兴，因为他说我们老是搬家：delete因为

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 很多墓地得我祭拜：我得去很多墓地祭拜，The subject comes before the modal verb, and the modal verb must come before the verb phrase it modifies. [rule: none]
Run 2: 很多墓地得我祭拜：我得去很多墓地祭拜，The person who has the obligation must be placed before the modal verb; this version also makes the cemeteries the places visited for the worship activity. [rule: none]
Run 3: 很多墓地得我祭拜：我得去很多墓地祭拜，The person who has the obligation should be the subject before the modal verb 得; the places cannot be the subject of 得 in this meaning. [rule: none]

output.reason: All runs identify the incorrect word order and subject assignment around 得 and give the same acceptable correction.
